parallel.conclusion: spacing-only retune does not close lane/label/outer-route/obstacle tradeoffs; group-level allocation remains diagnostic

startupContract.inputAuthority: stored/authored coordinates remain authoritative; coordinate-less input uses current deterministic derived placement
startupContract.placement: fixed small deterministic computation with whole-result fallback; no Product-authoritative quality search at startup
startupContract.baselinePresentation: one bounded current Product routing/label/viewport derivation sufficient to make the graph inspectable
startupContract.readiness: interaction-ready only after one internally consistent baseline presentation snapshot is committed
startupContract.degradation: dense graphs may return lower quality, but must not start an unbounded candidate search or silently change authority
startupContract.runtimeRequirement: placement should remain within a small fixed budget; complete graph-ready latency needs a separately measured browser/main-thread budget

qualityPhaseContract.inputSnapshot: Dataset identity/version, current session positions, stored-coordinate authority, manual route/label/Self-loop overrides, and presentation inputs
qualityPhaseContract.ownership: proposes Node geometry and coarse spatial/angular capacity only
qualityPhaseContract.verification: calls existing ordinary routing, Parallel/Incident, Self-loop, Relation-label, Node-label, endpoint-plan, and viewport authorities iteratively
qualityPhaseContract.execution: budgeted asynchronous/cooperatively chunked job; Web Worker is an implementation option, not an adopted requirement
qualityPhaseContract.cancellation: generation token plus cooperative cancellation; stale or input-invalidated results are discarded without mutating session state
qualityPhaseContract.preview: candidate remains separate from current session positions until explicit acceptance
qualityPhaseContract.accept: replaces session positions, marks adopted Entity coordinates and coordinatesDirty, preserves explicit Save Coordinates
qualityPhaseContract.rejectOrRevert: restores the pre-operation session snapshot; automatic Dataset persistence is prohibited
qualityPhaseContract.manualConflict: manual geometry/presentation edits during a run cancel or invalidate that run; manual route/label/Self-loop authority is retained in verification
qualityPhaseContract.repeatability: same input snapshot, algorithm version, and budget policy must produce the same result

options.name: Single Initial Placement / single startup path
options.startupBoundedness: strong for current placement, incomplete for quality-complete presentation
options.qualityCeiling: weak: expensive coupled verification must remain in startup and tested bounded compression loses quality/recall
options.coordinateCompatibility: simple, but every stronger search delays first interaction
options.mainThreadRisk: high if Product-authoritative candidate evaluation is expanded at startup
options.evidence: current placement is fast; dense route/label residuals and failed structural/Self-loop compression oppose a quality-complete single path
options.disposition: HOLD AS QUALITY-COMPLETE ARCHITECTURE; RETAIN AS FAST BASELINE

options.name: Fast Initial Placement + explicit High-quality Auto Layout
options.startupBoundedness: strong: retains current deterministic startup baseline
options.qualityCeiling: potentially higher: explicit budget permits more Product-authoritative proposal/verification cycles
options.coordinateCompatibility: compatible with current explicit Auto Layout and Save Coordinates separation if preview/accept/revert is added
options.mainThreadRisk: manageable only with bounded asynchronous or cooperative execution and cancellation
options.evidence: runtime separation, existing explicit operation boundary, and downstream coupling support the split; production quality solver is not established
options.disposition: PROVISIONALLY ADOPT EXECUTION SPLIT / QUALITY SOLVER HOLD

options.name: Adaptive Initial Placement Cascade
options.qualityCeiling: not shown to exceed explicit quality operation
options.coordinateCompatibility: adds hidden policy and expectation complexity at startup
options.mainThreadRisk: risk of variable latency and state-space growth
options.evidence: no new evidence reactivates the hypothesis

decision.executionArchitecture: B: Fast Initial Placement + explicit High-quality Auto Layout
decision.productIntegration: HOLD; no provider/default or behavior change
rationale: current placement is deterministic and negligible compared with Product presentation cost
quality-complete startup would internalize expensive globally coupled routing/label/endpoint evaluation
existing Product already has an explicit Auto Layout and explicit Save Coordinates boundary
no tested quality solver safely closes dense, Parallel/label, or Self-loop residuals
